entries.text: Nasdaq −2.6% on Thursday; Anthropic's draft prospectus shows $16.3bn H1 revenue. IPO expected in November.
Anthropic's public prospectus (revenue up about 14× in H1, $112bn cash) lifted the Nasdaq over 1% before Big Tech earnings.
SVP deadline closed: seven candidates, Aeschi undecided. Vote on 9 December.
Fed hikes to 3.75–4.00%, first hike since 2023.
US 10-year peaks at 5.36%, highest since 2002.
Bond rally: 10-year back below 5% as money leaves AI stocks. Fed decides 28 Oct.

title: Fed, rates and the bond market

entries.text: About 550,000 protest; Limoges town hall burned.
10-year yield briefly above 5%, spread to Bunds near 160 bp; Moody's holds the rating.
US–Israeli air campaign against Iran begins.
Ceasefire ends the heaviest fighting.
Interim truce collapses; Iran resumes attacks on shipping.
Houthi strikes on Saudi airports and oil sites; Brent at its highest since May; Iran says Hormuz management will change permanently.
Saudi defence minister in Tehran for de-escalation talks; Brent falls about 4.7% from its six-month high.
Houthis claim a strike on Ras Tanura; WSJ says the US and Israel plan short strikes on Iran after the midterms; Qatar hands Tehran a peace proposal.
Washington writes to Tehran to restart truce talks and Gulf states push a deal to reopen Hormuz; oil falls, but the US says strikes resume if talks fail.
MSCI finalises rules for 'non-operating companies'.
Final list due 11 Nov, effective after 30 Nov; JPMorgan estimates ~$2.8bn of forced selling of the stock.
FINMA approves BBIT, the first retail spot Bitcoin fund; SIX listing in November.
Witkoff meets Putin in St. Petersburg; no agreement. Starlink back to full speed after throttling.
Kyiv pauses refinery strikes at US request and the Oleshky local ceasefire holds a third day, while Russia kills 14 in Dnipro.
